title: Implement dynamic cumulative Total Completed tracking and optional batch dispatch entry

requirements.text: Update the DailyProductionReportForm component at frontend/src/components/DailyProductionReportForm.tsx to change the 'Total Completed' field from a manual input to a read-only calculated field that automatically computes the cumulative running total by fetching all previous production records for the selected operation from the database and adding today's production value to the sum

quotes: Total Completed = cumulative running total from database

acceptanceCriteria: Total Completed field is displayed as read-only in the form
Total Completed value is automatically calculated as: (sum of all previous today_production values for this operation) + (current today_production value)
The calculation fetches data from the backend database for the selected operation
Total Completed updates automatically when today_production value changes

requirements.text: Update the backend createDailyProductionReport and updateDailyProductionReport functions in backend/main.mo to automatically calculate and store the cumulative total_completed value by querying all previous daily production reports for the given operation_id, summing their today_production values, and adding the current today_production value

quotes: Total Completed = cumulative running total from database

acceptanceCriteria: Backend calculates total_completed automatically before saving the record
Calculation queries all existing records with matching operation_id
Formula: total_completed = sum(previous_records.today_production) + current_today_production
User cannot manually override the total_completed value

requirements.text: Update the DailyProductionReportForm component to automatically calculate and display the 'In Hand' field as a read-only value computed as Total Completed minus Despatch (In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch), recalculating whenever either Total Completed or Despatch values change
acceptanceCriteria: In Hand field is displayed as read-only
In Hand is calculated as: Total Completed - Despatch
Value updates automatically when Total Completed or Despatch changes
Display shows 0 or positive values only

requirements.text: Add an optional 'Batch Dispatch Entry' input field at the top of the DailyProductionReportForm component that, when filled with a dispatch quantity value, automatically populates the Despatch field for all 17 operations with the same value, allowing administrators to enter a single container dispatch count that applies to all operations simultaneously

quotes: If Despatch is same for all rows (container dispatch count), allow a single dispatch entry at top and auto-apply to all rows

acceptanceCriteria: Batch Dispatch Entry field appears at the top of the form above individual operation entries
Field is labeled clearly as 'Apply Same Dispatch to All Operations' or similar
When a value is entered, all 17 operation Despatch fields are automatically filled with that value
Field is optional and can be left empty for individual dispatch entry
Clearing the batch field does not clear individual Despatch values already entered

requirements.text: Update the ContainerDailyReportPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportPage.tsx to display calculated values for each operation row using the formula: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch, ensuring all numeric columns show accurate computed values based on database records
acceptanceCriteria: In Hand column displays calculated values (Total Completed - Despatch) for each operation
Calculation is performed on the frontend after fetching data
All 17 operations show correct calculated In Hand values
Zero or empty records display 0 for In Hand calculation

constraints: Maintain the existing single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify the 17 predefined operations list or their order
Total Completed must always be a calculated cumulative value, never manually entered
In Hand must always be calculated as Total Completed minus Despatch
Batch dispatch entry is optional and must not interfere with individual operation dispatch entry
nonGoals: Changing the operation names or order
Adding backend support for batch dispatch as a separate entity
Modifying the database schema to store In Hand separately
Creating new dispatch tracking mechanisms outside daily production reports
